lines.en: Tendrils sway gently at my side.

lines.zh: 我的速度不该属于陆地。
lines.en: This speed doesn't belong on land.
The tide went out, so I walked ashore.

lines.zh: 走过的地面都在冒水汽。
lines.en: The ground steams where I pass.
I need no road, only moisture.
My body brushes past the trunks.
My shadow looks wetter than I am.
Every step is a slow corrosion.
I keep to the waterline.

lines.zh: 陆地比海难走，但我会适应。
lines.en: Land is harder than sea — I'm adapting.
I stand and let the damp rise.

lines.zh: 体内的水晶在慢慢转动。
lines.en: The crystal inside turns slowly.
I listen for the sea's direction.
This ground is already turning salt.

lines.zh: 我看不见眼睛，却看得清。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I see clearly.

lines.zh: 穿过我的风都变得潮湿。
lines.en: Wind goes moist passing through me.
Waiting to grow another layer.
My shell grows armor-like.
This body repairs itself.
Counting the rhythm of the tides.
There's a faint salt in the air.
I spread myself a little wider.
Slime remains on the ground.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只需要水。
lines.en: I need no breath, only water.
Death isn't an end for me.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能吃饱的地方。
lines.en: Waiting for somewhere to feed.

lines.zh: 你身上的水分正在减少。
lines.en: The water in you is running low.
I can smell your heartbeat.
You're standing inside my tideline.

lines.zh: 这一身皮，可以变成什么。
lines.en: That skin of yours could become something.
You shouldn't come this near the sea.
I've memorized your shape.
Your fear is fresh.

lines.zh: 陆地生物总以为自己安全。
lines.en: Land creatures always think they're safe.

lines.zh: 我见过你的同类沉下去。
lines.en: I've seen your kind sink.
Weapon raised. Very brave.
Your breathing is too loud.
I'll adapt to you, slowly.
A layer of shell broke. It'll regrow.
Part of me has flowed away.
Pain is a temporary signal.
My body is pulling itself together.
Brine seeps from the wound.
This damage is nothing.
I shrank a little, then spread again.
The crystal core inside me is burning.
I need to retreat to the water.
I won't die yet. Don't rush.
Food? I prefer it living.
That smell of flesh excites me.
Put it down and leave the water's edge.
Soak it first, then hold it out.
You're buying time with food.

lines.zh: 我喜欢湿润的、会动的东西。
lines.en: I like things moist and moving.
That morsel isn't enough.

lines.zh: 你的手在发抖，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your hand's shaking. I smell it.
The tide will bring more.
I'll take this as tribute.
You bumped into water.

lines.zh: 我的身体不硬，却也不散。
lines.en: My body isn't hard, but it won't scatter.

lines.zh: 越挣，我的黏丝缠得越紧。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the tighter the strands bind.
I press close and the temperature drops.

lines.zh: 退开，你身上会沾上咸味。
lines.en: Back away or you'll smell of salt.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有骨头挡着。
lines.en: There are no bones between us.

lines.zh: 脚底下，我的触须缠了上来。
lines.en: Underfoot, my tendrils curl around you.
This close suits me.
Push me and I flow apart, then back.

lines.zh: 我这一身水，比石头还沉。
lines.en: This body of water weighs more than stone.

lines.zh: 我们在水里不这样繁衍。
lines.en: We don't multiply that way in the water.
My kind splits to grow.

lines.zh: 你说的这些，对我没意义。
lines.en: That means nothing to me.
We only feed and evolve.
Wrong species for that question.
There's only a crystal core inside me.
The tide doesn't ask such things.
My mate is the whole sea.
Don't use land words on me.
Ask again when you've become seaborn.
This belongs to the sea now.
My tendrils wrap it in salt water.
Wet things interest me more.
A piece of meat. I'll take it.
Not worth bending for.
I draw the shard into myself.
Want this? Too late.
It's already corroding.
I drag it back toward the water.
All of it becomes nourishment.
Your scent has spread.
Marked. Don't back away.
The tide rises at your feet.
I'm measuring your body heat.
Running north won't help.
This stretch of water is mine.

lines.zh: 你的心跳已经被潮水记住。
lines.en: The tide has memorized your heartbeat.
The distance is closing.
First I'll corrode the ground you stand on.
You're standing in my domain.
I meant to wait longer.

lines.zh: 你已经带上了海的气味。
lines.en: You already carry the sea's scent.
Come. The water will catch you.
Your reaction is too slow.

lines.zh: 我看你像一块会走路的肉。
lines.en: You look like meat that walks.
One touch is all I need.

lines.zh: 潮声变大了，你听见了吗。
lines.en: The surf grew louder. Do you hear it?
The air here is turning salt.

lines.zh: 你躲在石头后，我绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind the stone, and I go around.
Water seeps through the seams.
Waiting for your second breath.
You're slowing down.
No hurry. The sea waits.
I stretch out and cling to the ground.
Your weapon's wet. It'll slip.
Half a circle to cut your way.
The mud is sinking under you.
I'm tightening, little by little.

lines.zh: 你每一次抬脚都更费力。
lines.en: Every step costs you more.

lines.zh: 你的汗里有咸味，我喜欢。
lines.en: There's salt in your sweat, and I like it.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经适应你的速度。
lines.en: This body has adapted to your speed.
Your left leg carries an old injury.
I'll grow one more layer here.
You can't cut through a whole tide.
The water's at your knees.

lines.zh: 你退一步，水就漫上一层。
lines.en: Each step back, the water climbs a level.
Every wet mark here is mine.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，你就走不动了。
lines.en: A little longer and you can't move.
A tendril coils around your leg.

lines.zh: 整片水连同我一起推过去。
lines.en: I drive the whole sheet of water before me.
This blow carries brine.
My shell is harder than your blade.

lines.zh: 你被缠住了，动一动试试。
lines.en: You're tangled. Try moving.
Water seeps into your seams.
I tear your gear open.
Don't struggle — it sinks deeper.
This one carries corrosion.
Two steps back isn't far enough.
The tendril releases and coils again.
I strike the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 这一下你自己撞上来的。
lines.en: You threw yourself into that one.
Your blood warms the water.
The tide pushed me ashore.
I rise out of the shallows.

lines.zh: 这具身体是新的，还很软。
lines.en: This body is new and still soft.

lines.zh: 水沿着我的轮廓往下流。
lines.en: Water runs down my outline.

lines.zh: 我脚下的沙子开始发黑。
lines.en: The sand beneath me darkens.
The smell of the sea grows thick.
Testing these new legs.

lines.zh: 陆地，我要记住你的形状。
lines.en: Land, I'll remember your shape.

lines.zh: 我体内有一颗晶体在发亮。
lines.en: A crystal glows inside me.
I lift my head and look for prey.
The nearby water flows toward me.
Another tendril has grown.

lines.zh: 空气干燥得让人不舒服。
lines.en: The air is unpleasantly dry.

lines.zh: 我落地时，泥地吸住了我。
lines.en: Landing, the mud grips me.
The sea of this world is calling.

lines.zh: 我还没死过，所以还活着。
lines.en: I haven't died yet, so I live.

lines.zh: 我先适应潮汐，再适应你。
lines.en: I'll adapt to the tide, then to you.
My name is written on water.
The shore is busy. Good.

lines.zh: 我站起来了，比昨晚更高。
lines.en: I stand taller than last night.

lines.zh: 火焰把水分从我身上逼出去。
lines.en: Fire drives the water out of me.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，散了一地。
lines.en: I fell from height and scattered.

lines.zh: 水本该是我的家，这次却淹了我。
lines.en: Water was my home — this time it drowned me.

lines.zh: 冲击让我的壳裂成碎片。
lines.en: The blast cracked my shell to pieces.

lines.zh: 一枚尖物穿进我的躯体。
lines.en: Something sharp pierced my body.

lines.zh: 咒力灼烧我体内的晶核。
lines.en: That spell burns my inner crystal.

lines.zh: 没有养分，我在慢慢干瘪。
lines.en: No nourishment — I'm drying thin.

lines.zh: 电在水里散开，也散进我身体。
lines.en: Current spreads through water, and through me.
There's no water here. No tide.
